primary_title: Requirement for Y706 of the murine (or Y708 of the human) CSF-1 receptor for STAT1 activation in response to CSF-1
decision_basis: Y706F selectively reduces STAT1 activation and the corresponding human Y708 phosphopeptide competes STAT1-containing complexes, supporting the bounded orthologous CSF1R site-to-STAT1 edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve murine Y706 versus human Y708 numbering, FDC-P1 ectopic-receptor and human phosphopeptide context; STAT1 is not promoted as a terminal TF and no SCI transfer is made.
